source_text: Influential institutions like Egypt's Al-Azhar University have issued mixed fatwas on the matter, with earlier rulings in the 1980s and 1990s permitting mild forms of female "circumcision" (khitan al-banat) as culturally acceptable if not excessive, influencing Sudanese clerics who view it as permissible under fiqh traditions. [20]
